mapper.select: SELECT g.id,g.tenant_id,g.application_id,g.environment,g.membership_id,g.generation,g.role_id,g.scope,g.source_type,g.source_id, g.valid_from,g.valid_to,g.state,g.version,g.zed_token,g.group_id FROM auth_governance.access_grant g WHERE AND g.role_id=#{role} AND g.id > #{after} ORDER BY g.id LIMIT 21

SELECT g.id,g.tenant_id,g.application_id,g.environment,g.membership_id,g.generation,g.role_id,g.scope,g.source_type,g.source_id, g.valid_from,g.valid_to,g.state,g.version,g.group_id,g.zed_token AS graph_token,s.rule_json,s.content_hash AS scope_hash, COALESCE(m.status='ACTIVE' AND u.status='ACTIVE' AND u.kind='HUMAN' AND t.status='ACTIVE' AND m.valid_from <=clock_timestamp() AND (m.valid_to IS NULL OR m.valid_to >clock_timestamp()),false) AS member_active, m.version AS membership_version,m.valid_from AS member_valid_from,m.valid_to AS member_valid_to, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM auth_governance.policy_partition pp WHERE pp.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND pp.application_id=g.application_id AND pp.environment=g.environment) AS strict_partition, COALESCE(dg.active AND src.environment=g.environment AND NOT src.quarantined AND src.business_zone IS NOT NULL,false) AS group_available FROM auth_governance.access_grant g LEFT JOIN auth_governance.grant_scope s ON s.grant_id=g.id AND s.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND s.application_id=g.application_id AND s.environment=g.environment LEFT JOIN auth_governance.membership m ON m.id=g.membership_id AND m.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND m.generation=g.generation LEFT JOIN auth_governance.principal u ON u.id=m.principal_id LEFT JOIN auth_governance.directory_group dg ON dg.id=g.group_id AND dg.tenant_id=g.tenant_id LEFT JOIN auth_governance.directory_source src ON src.id=dg.source_id AND src.tenant_id=g.tenant_id JOIN auth_governance.tenant t ON t.id=g.tenant_id WHERE AND g.id IN #{id} ORDER BY g.id
